lines: In pity, look on me my God
Show Thy wonderful love to me
Forbid that I plan my life
Thou art the one who plans for me
My Father, lead me here on earth
Let me, Thy great salvation find.
Oh do not let me choose for Thee,
For Thou, my portion ever art
Oh do that which thou has ordained
For me, in Thy great heart of love.
Lord who can know Thy beginning
Thou Lord of glory, good and kind
Thou hast with Thee a thousand ways
When l have not yet thought out one.
As far and high as is the heaven
So are thy thoughts higher than mine
Lead me, that l may follow Thee
In the way of Thy righteousness

hymns.title: In pity, look on me my God

hymns.searchText: 6.6.6.8.8. hymn_1768344402257_0_c74a43b8 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 6.6.6.8.8. and he shall reign over the house of jacob. luk.1:33 rejoice, for jesus reigns enthroned in human hearts; he breaks the prison chains and makes them free indeed; the devil might god's child oppose no fear of foe, god's word goes on. the work of righteousness, tiding of truth and peace; for comfort in our life shall spread all round about; gentiles and jews shall all bow down and will worship acceptably. there's pow'r with thee for the protection of thine own; and to thy high decree shall millions take heed to; the heav'ns rejoice to see thy work the islands far hear thy command. this perfect heav'nly seed shall grow to a big tree; like the blessed leaven shall spread all o'er comes back again till god the son comes back again it will go on, amen, amen.

lines: And He shall reign over the house of Jacob. Luk.1:33
Rejoice, for Jesus reigns
Enthroned in human hearts;
He breaks the prison chains
And makes them free indeed;
The devil might God's child oppose
No fear of foe, God's word goes on.
The work of righteousness,
Tiding of truth and peace;
For comfort in our life
Shall spread all round about;
Gentiles and Jews shall all bow down
And will worship acceptably.
There's pow'r with Thee for the
Protection of Thine own;
And to Thy high decree
Shall millions take heed to;
The heav'ns rejoice to see Thy work
The islands far hear Thy command.
This perfect heav'nly seed
Shall grow to a big tree;
Like the blessed leaven
Shall spread all o'er comes back again
Till God the Son comes back again
It will go on, Amen, Amen.

hymns.searchText: 7.8.7. hymn_1768344402258_0_2ccacafd christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7.8.7. come now, let us reason together. saith the lord, through your sins be as scralet, they shall be as white as snow. is. 1:18 sinner, do come to the saviour who has come to save your soul your pain he bore on his body when he suffered in your place. eternal god is the one, who gave of his spirit to you heaven and earth shall pass away but god lives for ever more. before your days here are ended before death, your eyelids close hasten and seek for your saviour, now before it is too late. hear how his voice sweetly calls you "sinner, do come unto me", bring to me your burden of sin have hope, believe, do not fear.

lines: Come now, let us reason together.  Saith the
Lord, through your sins be as scralet, they shall
be as white as snow. Is. 1:18
Sinner, do come to the Saviour
Who has come to save your soul
Your pain he bore on His body
When he suffered in your place.
Eternal God is the one, who
Gave of His spirit to you
Heaven and earth shall pass away
But God lives for ever more.
Before your days here are ended
Before death, your eyelids close
Hasten and seek for your Saviour,
Now before it is too late.
Hear how His voice sweetly calls you
"Sinner, do come unto me",
Bring to me your burden of sin
Have hope, believe, do not fear.

hymns.searchText: 6.6.6. hymn_1768344402258_0_3ffd9069 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 6.6.6. and i will be with thy mouth and teach thee what thou shalt say. exd.4:12. shine thou upon us, lord, true light of men, to-day; and through the written word thy very self display; that so, from hearts which burn with gazing on thy face the little ones may learn the wonders of thy grace. brethren thou upon us, lord, thy spirit's living flame, that so with one accord our lips may tell thy name; give thou the hearing ear, fix thou the wandering thought, that those we teach may hear the great things thou has wrought. speak thou for us, o lord, in all we say of thee; according to thy word let all our teaching be; that so thy lambs may know their own true shepherd's voice, where'er he leads them go, and in his love rejoice.

lines: And I will be with thy mouth and teach thee what thou shalt say. Exd.4:12.
Shine Thou upon us, Lord,
True Light of men, to-day;
And through the written word
Thy very self display;
That so, from hearts which burn
With gazing on Thy face
The little ones may learn
The wonders of Thy grace.
Brethren Thou upon us, Lord,
Thy Spirit's living flame,
That so with one accord
Our lips may tell Thy name;
Give Thou the hearing ear,
Fix Thou the wandering thought,
That those we teach may hear
The great things Thou has wrought.
Speak Thou for us, O Lord,
In all we say of Thee;
According to Thy word
Let all our teaching be;
That so Thy lambs may know
Their own true Shepherd's voice,
Where'er He leads them go,
And in His love rejoice.

hymns.searchText: 7.8.7.8.7. hymn_1768344402258_0_47ef639b christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7.8.7.8.7. the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruetly. ps. 74:20. look with compassion on the coasts and the land of the heathen see, how in their thousands, they are struggling dying in sin darkness covers, darkness covers many lives in our vast land. the light of people in darkness arise, bring blessings to us light for those in heathen darkness come, with healing in thy wings let all the kings, let all the king come into thy blazing light. let all the heathens who worship gods of wood and gods of stone come, that they might fall down and bow before the almighty god let thy glory, let thy glory, cover all the land and see. thou, to whom all might is given speak the word, give the decree let the company of preachers proclaims thy name all abroad be thou with them, be thou with them even, lord unto the end.

lines: The dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruetly. Ps. 74:20.
Look with compassion on the coasts
And the land of the heathen
See, how in their thousands, they are
Struggling dying in sin
Darkness covers, darkness covers
Many lives in our vast land.
The light of people in darkness
Arise, bring blessings to us
Light for those in heathen darkness
Come, with healing in Thy wings
Let all the kings, let all the king
Come into Thy blazing light.
Let all the heathens who worship
Gods of wood and gods of stone
Come, that they might fall down and bow
Before the Almighty God
Let Thy glory, let thy glory,
Cover all the land and see.
Thou, to whom all might is given
Speak the word, give the decree
Let the company of preachers
Proclaims Thy name all abroad
Be Thou with them, be thou with them
Even, Lord unto the end.

hymns.searchText: 7.8.7.7.7. hymn_1768344402258_0_55b99f85 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7.8.7.7.7. speak lord, for thy servant heareth. 1. sam. 3:9. master, speak! thy servant heareth, waiting for thy gracious word longing for thy voice that cheereth; master! let it now be heard. i am listening lord, for thee, what hast thou to say to me? speak to me by name, o master, let me know it is to me; speak, that i may follow faster, with a step more firm and fire where the shepherd leads the flock, in the shadow of the rock. master, speak! though least and lowest let me not unheard depart, master, speak! for o thou knowest all the yearning of my heart, knowest all its truest need; speak! and make me blest indeed. master, speak! and make me ready, when thy voice is truly heard, with obedience glad and steady still to follow every word, i am listening, lord for thee; master, speak! o speak to me!

lines: Speak Lord, for Thy servant heareth. 1. Sam. 3:9.
Master, speak! Thy servant heareth,
Waiting for Thy gracious word
Longing for Thy voice that cheereth;
Master! let it now be heard.
I am listening Lord, for thee,
What hast Thou to say to me?
Speak to me by name, O Master,
Let me know it is to me;
Speak, that I may follow faster,
With a step more firm and fire
Where the Shepherd leads the flock,
In the shadow of the Rock.
Master, speak! though least and lowest
Let me not unheard depart,
Master, speak! for o Thou knowest
All the yearning of my heart,
Knowest all its truest need;
Speak! and make me blest indeed.
Master, speak! and make me ready,
When Thy voice is truly heard,
With obedience glad and steady
Still to follow every word,
I am listening, Lord for thee;
Master, speak! O speak to me!

hymns.searchText: go and tell of the glad tidings, hymn_1768344402258_0_400e34c9 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide go and tell of the glad tidings, make all the world to hear the news who hears and believes shall be saved those who refuse shall be condemned. i'll reveal to you great mysteries, ye shall show forth my word of truth in all the works that i have done and the miracles ye shall do. go heal the sick and raise the dead, in my great name cast out demons, let no my prophet ever fear, though jews and gentiles should deride. teach all the world my commandments and lo, i am with you always, to me belong all pow'r and might i can kill and can make alive. a light encircled him around, he ascended in great glory, the news was proclaim'd far and near the ascension of our saviour.

lines: Go and tell of the glad tidings,
Make all the world to hear the news
Who hears and believes shall be saved
Those who refuse shall be condemned.
I'll reveal to you great mysteries,
Ye shall show forth my word of truth
In all the works that I have done
And the miracles ye shall do.
Go heal the sick and raise the dead,
In my great name cast out demons,
Let no my prophet ever fear,
Though Jews and Gentiles should deride.
Teach all the world my commandments
And lo, I am with you always,
To me belong all pow'r and might
I can kill and can make alive.
A light encircled Him around,
He ascended in great glory,
The news was proclaim'd far and near
The ascension of our Saviour.

hymns.title: Go and tell of the glad tidings,

hymns.searchText: 6.6.6.4.4.4.4. hymn_1768344402258_0_797f5b9c christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 6.6.6.4.4.4.4. the kings of sheba and sheba shall ofter gifts. ps. 72:10. oh from the island bank to the end of the sea all kings bow for jesus and bring offering to him arab should sing the heav'nly song and afric join to sing his praise. the prince's shall worship their offerings they shall bring the pow'rs of god to praise emmanuel! our king. from far distance they shall worship the world would bow to his command.

lines: The Kings of sheba and sheba shall ofter gifts. Ps. 72:10.
Oh from the Island bank
To the end of the sea
All Kings bow for Jesus
And bring offering to Him
Arab should sing
The heav'nly song
And Afric join
To sing His praise.
The prince's shall worship
Their offerings they shall bring
The pow'rs of God to praise
Emmanuel! our King.
From far distance
They shall worship
The world would bow
To His command.

hymns.searchText: 7.8.7.8.7. hymn_1768344402258_0_26154b97 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7.8.7.8.7. a light to lighten the gentiles, luke. 2:32.] millions groping yet in darkness think, my heart and be thou still, each of god' own promise tells us of a glorious happy morn day of gladness, day of gladness, may that day dawn on us soon. let all india and africa men of different tribes and creed know the great and glorious vict'ry freely giv'n on calvary may the gospel, may the gospel be proclaimed from shore to shore, all the kingdoms yet in darkness send the gospel light to them form the sunrise to the sunset may the light dispel the gloom may redemption, may redemption, freely bestowed have full sway. march on, march on blessed gospel march on to full victory may thy everlasting kingdom multiply and never cease, blessed saviour, blessed saviour, come and reign all o'er the earth

lines: A light to lighten the Gentiles, Luke. 2:32.]
Millions groping yet in darkness
Think, my heart and be thou still,
Each of God' own promise tells us
Of a glorious happy morn
Day of gladness, day of gladness,
May that day dawn on us soon.
Let all India and Africa
Men of different tribes and creed
Know the great and glorious vict'ry
Freely giv'n on Calvary
May the Gospel, may the Gospel
Be proclaimed from shore to shore,
All the kingdoms yet in darkness
Send the gospel light to them
Form the sunrise to the sunset
May the light dispel the gloom
May Redemption, may Redemption,
Freely bestowed have full sway.
March on, March on blessed Gospel
March on to full victory
May Thy everlasting kingdom
Multiply and never cease,
Blessed Saviour, blessed Saviour,
Come and reign all o'er the earth

hymns.searchText: 7.9.7.7.10.& ref. hymn_1768344402258_0_e8578684 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7.9.7.7.10.& ref. behold, to obey is better than sacrifice. 1 sam.15:22. just as god who reigns on high spake to men in days gone by, so the lord is calling men today; and, my brother this is true, whatso-e'er he says to you there is but one thing to do, just obey. just obey, just obey, is the way, god's way; when his message comes to you, there is but one thing to do, just obey, just obey. if you're in the saviour's hand, you must do as he commands, for there is no other gospel way; never put the message by, never stop to reason why, when the saviour speaks to you. if for mansions fair you sigh in that land beyond the sky, after time with you has pass'd away; tho' the way you may not see, christ is calling "follow me". faith and duty both will cry just obey.

lines: Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice. 1 Sam.15:22.
Just as God who reigns on High
Spake to men in days gone by,
So the Lord is calling men today;
And, my brother this is true,
Whatso-e'er He says to you
There is but one thing to do, just obey.
Just obey, just obey,
Is the way, God's way;
When His message comes to you,
There is but one thing to do,
Just obey, just obey.
If you're in the Saviour's hand,
You must do as He commands,
For there is no other gospel way;
Never put the message by,
Never stop to reason why,
When the Saviour speaks to you.
If for mansions fair you sigh
In that land beyond the sky,
After time with you has pass'd away;
Tho' the way you may not see,
Christ is calling "Follow Me".
Faith and duty both will cry just obey.

hymns.title: 7.9.7.7.10.& Ref.

hymns.searchText: 6.7.6.d. hymn_1768344402258_0_ff008ab4 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 6.7.6.d. so we, thy people and sheep of thy pasture, will give thee thanks forever, we will show forth thy praise to all generations. ps. 79:13. o god of our salvation our spirit soul and life our health, shield and defender our everlasting, peace we thy children humbly stand to glorify thy name for the great gift you bestow through jesus christ thy son. our hearts are filled with praises for all thy ceaseless care on all of thy dear children scattered all o'er the world we implore thee to help us continue in thy will and that our light may so shine upon the whole wide world. glory to god the father glory to god the son to holy ghost give glory ever blessed three-in-one accept our songs of praises also the prayer we bring for the great gift you bestow through jesus christ thy son.

lines: So we, Thy people and sheep of Thy pasture, will give Thee thanks forever, we will show forth Thy praise to all generations. Ps. 79:13.
O God of our salvation
Our Spirit soul and life
Our health, shield and defender
Our everlasting, peace
We Thy children humbly stand
To glorify Thy name
For the great gift you bestow
Through Jesus Christ Thy Son.
Our hearts are filled with praises
For all Thy ceaseless care
On all of Thy dear children
Scattered all o'er the world
We implore Thee to help us
Continue in Thy will
And that our light may so shine
Upon the whole wide world.
Glory to God the Father
Glory to God the Son
To Holy Ghost give glory
Ever blessed Three-in-One
Accept our songs of praises
Also the prayer we bring
For the great gift you bestow
Through Jesus Christ Thy Son.

hymns.title: 6.7.6.D.

hymns.searchText: 8.9.8.7 & ref. hymn_1768344402259_0_6c3d3899 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 8.9.8.7 & ref. thy word is a lamb unto my feet and a light unto my path. ps.119:105. wonderful bible! book of god; guide and counsel to mortals giv'n; lamb to the path by the ransomed trod, lighting the way from earth to heav'n. shine, o wonderful light divine, lamb of truth, in this dark world shine shine thr'o the night of doubt, and fears, shine till the morn of god appears. wonderful bible! law of the lord; all its precepts in grace abound and in their keeping is great reward, life everlasting there is found. wonderful bible! radiance bright; ray serene from the world above, fairest of stars in humanity's night, fill now our hearts with light and love.

lines: Thy word is a lamb unto my feet and a light unto my path. Ps.119:105.
Wonderful Bible! Book of God;
Guide and counsel to mortals giv'n;
Lamb to the path by the ransomed trod,
Lighting the way from earth to heav'n.
Shine, O wonderful light divine,
Lamb of Truth, in this dark world shine
Shine thr'o the night of doubt, and fears,
Shine till the morn of God appears.
Wonderful Bible! Law of the Lord;
All its precepts in grace abound
And in their keeping is great reward,
Life everlasting there is found.
Wonderful Bible! Radiance bright;
Ray serene from the world above,
Fairest of stars in humanity's night,
Fill now our hearts with light and love.

hymns.title: 8.9.8.7 & Ref.

hymns.searchText: 7..7.7 hymn_1768344402259_0_08ce4baf christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7..7.7 oh, how love i thy law ps. 119:97 holy bible, book divine, precious treasure, thou art mine; mine, to tell me whence i came; mine, to teach me what i am. mine, to chide me when i rove; mine, to show a saviour's love; mine art thou to guide my feet; mine, to judge, condemn, acquit. mine, to comfort in distress, if the holy spirit bless; mine, to show by living faith man can triumph over death. mine, to tell of joys to come, light and life beyond the tomb; holy bible, book divine, precious treasure, thou art mine.

lines: Oh, how love I Thy law Ps. 119:97
Holy Bible, book divine,
Precious treasure, thou art mine;
Mine, to tell me whence I came;
Mine, to teach me what I am.
Mine, to chide me when I rove;
Mine, to show a Saviour's love;
Mine art thou to guide my feet;
Mine, to judge, condemn, acquit.
Mine, to comfort in distress,
If the Holy Spirit bless;
Mine, to show by living faith
Man can triumph over death.
Mine, to tell of joys to come,
Light and life beyond the tomb;
Holy Bible, book divine,
Precious treasure, thou art mine.

hymns.searchText: 6.7.6.d hymn_1768344402259_0_9e855b1f christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 6.7.6.d thy word is lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path ps 119:105 o word of god incarnate, o wisdom from on high, o truth unchanged, unchanging, o light of our dark sky, we praise thee for the radiance that from the hallowed page, a lantern to our footsteps, shine n from age to age the church from her sear master received the gift divine, and still that light she lifteth, o'er all the earth to shine it is the golden casket where gems of truth are stored; of christ, the living word. it flloateth like a banner before god's host unfurled; it shineth like a beacon above the darkling world; it is the chart and compass that,o'er life surging sea, mid mists and rocks, and quick-sands, still guides, o christ, to thee o make thy church, dear saviour, a lamp of burnished gold, to bear before the nations thy true light, as of old, o teach thy wandering pilgrims by this their path to trace, till, clouds and darkness ended, they see thee face to face.

lines: Thy word is lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path Ps 119:105
O word of God incarnate,
O wisdom from on high,
O truth unchanged, unchanging,
O light of our dark sky,
We praise Thee for the radiance
That from the hallowed page,
A lantern to our footsteps,
Shine n from age to age
The Church from her sear Master
Received the gift divine,
And still that light she lifteth,
O'er all the earth to shine
It is the golden casket
Where gems of truth are stored;
Of Christ, the living Word.
It flloateth like a banner
Before God's host unfurled;
It shineth like a beacon
Above the darkling world;
It is the chart and compass
That,o'er life surging sea,
Mid mists and rocks, and quick-sands,
Still guides, O Christ, to Thee
O make Thy Church, dear Saviour,
A lamp of burnished gold,
To bear before the nations
Thy true light, as of old,
O teach Thy wandering pilgrims
By this their path to trace,
Till, clouds and darkness ended,
They see Thee face to face.

hymns.title: 6.7.6.D

hymns.searchText: 6.6.6. hymn_1768344402259_0_784ceaca christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 6.6.6. thy word is a lamp unto my feet. lord, thy word abideth, and our footsteps guideth; who its truth believeth light and joy receiveth. when our foes are near us, then thy word doth cheer us, word of consolation, message of salvation. when the storms are o'er us, and dark clouds before us, then its light directeth, and our way protecteth. who can tell the pleasure, who recount the treasure, by thy word imparted to the simple-hearted? word of mercy, giving succour to the living; word of life, supplying comfort to the dying! o that we, dicserning its most holy learning lord, may love and fear thee, evermore be near thee!.

lines: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet.
Lord, Thy word abideth,
And our footsteps guideth;
Who its truth believeth
Light and joy receiveth.
When our foes are near us,
Then Thy word doth cheer us,
Word of consolation,
Message of salvation.
When the storms are o'er us,
And dark clouds before us,
Then its light directeth,
And our way protecteth.
Who can tell the pleasure,
Who recount the treasure,
By Thy word imparted
To the simple-hearted?
Word of mercy, giving
Succour to the living;
Word of life, supplying
Comfort to the dying!
O that we, dicserning
Its most holy learning
Lord, may love and fear Thee,
Evermore be near Thee!.

hymns.searchText: 4.6.4.d. hymn_1768344402259_0_c77c123a christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 4.6.4.d. jesus said unto them come and dine. joh.21:12. break thou the bread of life, o lord, to me, as thou didst break the loaves beside the sea: beyond the sacred page. i seek thee, lord; my spirit pants for thee, o living word!. thou art the bread of life, o lord, to me, thy holy word the truth that saveth me: give me to eat and live with thee above; teach me to love thy truth, for thou art love. o send thy spirit, lord, now unto me, that he may touch my eyes, and make me see show me the truth concealed within thy word, and in thy book revealed i see the lord.

lines: Jesus said unto them come and dine. Joh.21:12.
Break Thou the bread of life,
O Lord, to me,
As Thou didst break the loaves
Beside the sea:
Beyond the sacred page.
I seek thee, Lord;
My spirit pants for Thee,
O living word!.
Thou art the Bread of Life,
O Lord, to me,
Thy holy word the truth
That saveth me:
Give me to eat and live
With thee above;
Teach me to love Thy truth,
For Thou art love.
O send Thy spirit, Lord,
Now unto me,
That He may touch my eyes,
And make me see
Show me the truth concealed
Within Thy word,
And in Thy book revealed
I see the Lord.

hymns.title: 4.6.4.D.

hymns.searchText: 7.8.7. hymn_1768344402259_0_ce771ca3 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7.8.7. blessed are they that hear the word of god and keep it. luk.11:28 o how blest the hour, lord jesus, when we can to thee draw near, promises so sweet and precious from thy gracious lips to hear! be with us this day to bless us, that we may not hear in vain; with the saving truths impress us, which the words of life contain. see us, eager for salvation, sit, great master, at thy feet, and with breathless expectation hang upon thine accents sweet. open thou our minds, and lead us safely on our heavenward way; with the lamp of truth precede us, that we may not go astray. make us gentle, meek, and humble, and yet bold in doing right: scatter darkness, lest we stumble; men walk safely in the light. lord, endure thy word from heaven with such light, and pow'r, that in us its silent leaven may work on from hour to hour. give us grace to bear our witness to the truths we have embraced; and let others both their sweetness and their quick'ning virtue taste.

lines: Blessed are they that hear the word of God and keep it. Luk.11:28
O How blest the hour, Lord Jesus,
When we can to Thee Draw near,
Promises so sweet and precious
From Thy gracious lips to hear!
Be with us this day to bless us,
That we may not hear in vain;
With the saving truths impress us,
Which the words of life contain.
See us, eager for salvation,
Sit, great Master, at Thy feet,
And with breathless expectation
Hang upon Thine accents sweet.
Open Thou our minds, and lead us
Safely on our heavenward way;
With the lamp of truth precede us,
That we may not go astray.
Make us gentle, meek, and humble,
And yet bold in doing right:
Scatter darkness, lest we stumble;
Men walk safely in the light.
Lord, endure Thy word from heaven
With such light, and pow'r,
That in us its silent leaven
May work on from hour to hour.
Give us grace to bear our witness
To the truths we have embraced;
And let others both their sweetness
And their quick'ning virtue taste.

hymns.searchText: 8.8.d. hymn_1768344402259_0_cfd408f5 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 8.8.d. and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children when thou sitteth in thine house. deut.6:7 when quiet in my house i sit, thy book be my companion still, my joy thy sayings to repeat, talk o'er the records of thy will, and search the oracles divine, till every heartfelt word be mine. o may the gracious word divine subject of all my converse be! so will the lord his follower join, and walk and himself with me; so shall my heart his presence prove, and burn with everlasting love. oft as i lay me down to rest, o may the reconciling word sweetly compose my weary breast! while, on the bosom of my lord, i sink in blissful dreams away, and visions of eternal day. rising to sing my saviour's praise, thee may i publish all day long; and let thy precious word of grace flow from my heart, and fill my tongue; fill all my life with purest love, and join me to the church above.

lines: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children when thou sitteth in thine house. Deut.6:7
When quiet in my house I sit,
Thy Book be my companion still,
My joy Thy sayings to repeat,
Talk o'er the records of thy will,
And search the oracles divine,
Till every heartfelt word be mine.
O may the gracious word divine
Subject of all my converse be!
So will the Lord His follower join,
And walk And Himself with me;
So shall my heart His presence prove,
And burn with everlasting love.
Oft as I lay me down to rest,
O may the reconciling word
Sweetly compose my weary breast!
While, on the bosom of my Lord,
I sink in blissful dreams away,
And visions of eternal day.
Rising to sing my Saviour's praise,
Thee may I publish all day long;
And let Thy precious word of grace
Flow from my heart, and fill my tongue;
Fill all my life with purest love,
And join me to the Church above.

hymns.title: 8.8.D.

hymns.searchText: 5.6.5. hymn_1768344402260_0_4a8c9afb christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 5.6.5. speak lord, for thy servant heareth. 1.sam. 3:9. speak, lord, in thy stillness, while i wait on thee, hushed my heart to listen in expectancy. speak, o blessed master, in this quiet hour, let me see thy face, lord, fee! thy touch of pow'r. for the words thou speakest "they are life indeed", living bread from heaven, now my spirit feed! satiate my being, with thy fullnesss fill; as the dew descending, let thy speech distil. all to thee is yielded, i am not mine own; blissful, glad surrender, i am thine alone. speak, thy servant heareth be not silent, lord! waits my soul upon thee for the quickn'ing won! fill me with the knowledge of thy glorious will; all thine own good pleasure in thy child fulfil. like a watered garden, full of fragrance rare, ling'ring in thy presence, let my life appear.

lines: Speak Lord, for thy servant heareth. 1.Sam. 3:9.
Speak, Lord, in Thy stillness,
While I wait on Thee,
Hushed my heart to listen
In expectancy.
Speak, O blessed Master,
In this quiet hour,
Let me see Thy face, Lord,
Fee! Thy touch of pow'r.
For the words Thou speakest
"They are life indeed",
Living bread from heaven,
Now my spirit feed!
Satiate my being,
With Thy fullnesss fill;
As the dew descending,
Let Thy speech distil.
All to Thee is yielded,
I am not mine own;
Blissful, glad surrender,
I am Thine alone.
Speak, Thy servant heareth
Be not silent, Lord!
Waits my soul upon Thee
For the quickn'ing won!
Fill me with the knowledge
Of Thy glorious will;
All Thine own good pleasure
In Thy child fulfil.
Like a watered garden,
Full of fragrance rare,
Ling'ring in Thy presence,
Let my life appear.

hymns.searchText: there is a book, who runs may read, hymn_1768344402260_0_380bb870 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide there is a book, who runs may read, which heav'nly truth imparts, and all the lore its scholars need, pure eyes and christian hearts. the works of god above, below within us and round, are pages in that book to show how god himself is found. the glorious sky embracing all is like the maker's love; wherewith encompass's great and small in peace and order move. one name, above all glorious names, with its ten thousand tongues the everlasting sea proclaims, echoing angelic songs. thou who hast giv'n me eyes to see and love this sight so fair, give me heart to find out thee, and read thee everywhere.

lines: There is a book, who runs may read,
Which heav'nly truth imparts,
And all the lore its scholars need,
Pure eyes and Christian hearts.
The works of God above, below
Within us and round,
Are pages in that book to show
How God Himself is found.
The glorious sky embracing all
Is like the Maker's love;
Wherewith encompass's great and small
In peace and order move.
One Name, above all glorious names,
With its ten thousand tongues
The everlasting sea proclaims,
Echoing angelic songs.
Thou who hast giv'n me eyes to see
And love this sight so fair,
Give me heart to find out Thee,
And read Thee everywhere.

hymns.title: There is a book, who runs may read,

hymns.searchText: father of mercies, in thy word hymn_1768344402260_0_a9c99bf9 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide father of mercies, in thy word what endless glory shines! for ever be thy name adored for these celestial lines. here springs of consolation rise to cheer the fainting mind: and thirsty souls receive supplies and sweet refreshment find. here the redeemer's welcome voice spreads heavenly peace around and life and everlasting joy attend the blissful sound. oh, may these heav'nly pages be my ever dear delight: and still new beauties may see, and still increasing light. divine instructor, gracious lord, be thou for ever near; teach me to love thy sacred word, and view my saviour there.

lines: Father of mercies, in Thy word
What endless glory shines!
For ever be Thy name adored
For these celestial lines.
Here springs of consolation rise
To cheer the fainting mind:
And thirsty souls receive supplies
And sweet refreshment find.
Here the Redeemer's welcome voice
Spreads heavenly peace around
And life and everlasting joy
Attend the blissful sound.
Oh, may these heav'nly pages be
My ever dear delight:
And still new beauties may see,
And still increasing light.
Divine Instructor, gracious Lord,
Be Thou for ever near;
Teach me to love Thy sacred word,
And view my Saviour there.

hymns.title: Father of mercies, in Thy word

lines: All scriptures is given by inspiration of God. II. Tim. 3:16.
Inspirer of the ancient seers,
Who wrote from Thee the sacred page,
The same through all succeeding years,
To us, in our degenerate age,
The spirit of Thy word impart,
And breathe the life into our heart.
While now Thine oracles we read,
With earnest pray'r and strong desire,
Let Thy Spirit from Thee proceed,
Our souls awaken and inspire,
Our weakness help, our darkness chase,
And guide us by the light of grace!
Whene'er in error's paths sword,
The living God through sin forsake,
Our conscience by Thy word reprove,
Convince and bring the wand'rers back,
Deep wounded by Thy Spirit's sword,
And then by Gilead's balm restored.
the sacred lessons of thy grace,
Transmitted through Thy word, repeat,
And train us up in all Thy ways,
To make us in Thy will complete,
Fulfil Thy love's redeeming plan,
And bring us to a perfect stand.
Furnish'd out of Thy tresury,
O may we always ready stand
To help the souls redeemed by Thee,
In what their various states demand,
To teach, convince, correct, reprove,
And build them up in holiest love!

hymns.title: 8.8.D.

hymns.searchText: thy words unto my taste are sweet, hymn_1768344402260_0_c06a782a christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide thy words unto my taste are sweet, o lord of hosts, thy truth i love; the light it shed, before my feet streams from thy dazzling place above! o joy, within the page of find such wondrous treasures all my own; to trace the mysteries of thy mind, and reach the splendours of thy throne! no human wisdom touched that height, no creature tongue sang that high strain thy health breath'd forth the holy light, the finger scroll'd the message plain, yet, mighty word, thou stoopedst low to falt'ring lip and feeble hand, for humble men spake long ago such wisdom as thy spirit planned. to profit him that hungereth with rich delight and doctrine pure, to quicken love and strengthen faith and make his heav'nly calling sure. o truth, who grandly traced the way, o love, who trod it with delight, grant all thy children grace, we pray, to walk well-pleasing in thy sight.

lines: Thy words unto my taste are sweet,
O Lord of hosts, Thy truth I love;
The light it shed, before my feet
Streams from Thy dazzling place above!
O Joy, within the page of find
Such wondrous treasures all my own;
To trace the mysteries of Thy mind,
And reach the splendours of Thy throne!
No human wisdom touched that height,
No creature tongue sang that high strain
Thy health breath'd forth the holy light,
The finger scroll'd the message plain,
Yet, Mighty Word, Thou stoopedst low
To falt'ring lip and feeble hand,
For humble men spake long ago
Such wisdom as Thy Spirit planned.
To profit him that hungereth
With rich delight and doctrine pure,
To quicken love and strengthen faith
And make his heav'nly calling sure.
O Truth, who grandly traced the Way,
O Love, who trod it with delight,
Grant all Thy children grace, we pray,
To walk well-pleasing in Thy sight.

hymns.title: Thy words unto my taste are sweet,

hymns.searchText: father of all, in whom alone hymn_1768344402260_0_c426b51f christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide father of all, in whom alone we live, and move, and breathe, one bright celestial ray dart down, and cheer thy sons beneath. while in thy word we search for thee we search with trembling awe! open our eyes, and let us see the wonders of thy law. now let our darkness comprehend the light that shines so clear, now the revealing spirit send, and give us ears to hear. before us make thy goodness pass, which here by faith we know. let us in jesus see thy face, and die to all below.

lines: Father of all, in whom alone
We live, and move, and breathe,
One bright celestial ray dart down,
And cheer Thy sons beneath.
While in Thy word we search for Thee
We search with trembling awe!
Open our eyes, and let us see
The wonders of Thy law.
Now let our darkness comprehend
The light that shines so clear,
Now the revealing Spirit send,
And give us ears to hear.
Before us make Thy goodness pass,
Which here by faith we know.
Let us in Jesus see Thy face,
And die to all below.

hymns.title: Father of all, in whom alone

hymns.searchText: 6.7.6.d.7.ref. hymn_1768344402260_0_db9961ec christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 6.7.6.d.7.ref. hear all that the lord god shall say. deut. 5:27. speak to my soul lord jesus, speak now in tend'rest tone; whisper in loving-kindness; "thou art not let alone". open my heart to hear thee, quickly to hear thy voice, fill thou my soul with praises, let me in thee rejoice. speak thou in softest whispers whispers of love to me thou shalt be always conq'ror thou shalt be always free speak thou to me each day lord always in tend'rest tone let me now hear thy whisper "thou art not left alone. speak to thy children ever, lead in the holy way; fill them with joy and gladness, teach them to watch and pray, may they in consecration yield their whole lives to thee, hasten thy coming kingdom, till our dear lord we see. speak now as in the old time thou didst reveal thy will; let me know all my duty, let me thy law fulfil, lead me to show thy praise, gladly to do thy bidding honour thee all my days.

lines: Hear all that the Lord God shall say. Deut. 5:27.
Speak to my soul Lord Jesus,
Speak now in tend'rest tone;
Whisper in loving-kindness;
"Thou art not let alone".
Open my heart to hear Thee,
Quickly to hear Thy voice,
Fill Thou my soul with praises,
Let me in Thee rejoice.
Speak Thou in softest whispers
Whispers of love to me
Thou shalt be always conq'ror
Thou shalt be always free
Speak Thou to me each day Lord
Always in tend'rest tone
Let me now hear Thy whisper
"Thou art not left alone.
Speak to Thy children ever,
Lead in the holy way;
Fill them with joy and gladness,
Teach them to watch and pray,
May they in consecration
Yield their whole lives to Thee,
Hasten thy coming kingdom,
Till our dear Lord we see.
Speak now as in the old time
Thou didst reveal Thy will;
Let me know all my duty,
Let me Thy law fulfil,
Lead me to show Thy praise,
Gladly to do Thy bidding
Honour Thee all my days.

hymns.title: 6.7.6.D.7.Ref.

hymns.searchText: almighty god, thy word is cast hymn_1768344402260_0_fe95fd64 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide almighty god, thy word is cast like seed into the ground, now let the dew of heav'n descend, and righteous fruits abound. let not the foe of christ and man this holy seed remove, but give it root in every heart to bring forth fruits of love. let not the world's deceitful cares the rising plant destroy, but let it yield a hundredfold the fruits of peace and joy. on as the precious seed it sown, thy quickening grace bestow, that all whose souls the truth receive its saving pow'r may know.

lines: Almighty God, thy word is cast
Like seed into the ground,
Now let the dew of heav'n descend,
And righteous fruits abound.
Let not the foe of Christ and man
This holy seed remove,
But give it root in every heart
To bring forth fruits of love.
Let not the world's deceitful cares
The rising plant destroy,
But let it yield a hundredfold
The fruits of peace and joy.
On as the precious seed it sown,
Thy quickening grace bestow,
That all whose souls the truth receive
Its saving pow'r may know.

hymns.title: Almighty God, thy word is cast

hymns.searchText: how shall our children and young ones hymn_1768344402261_0_0f3f6d04 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide how shall our children and young ones take heed and cleanse their way, only by taking heed thereto according to thy word. thy word entered into the heart, and sheds its light abroad, it gives wisdom's to the simple, and the knowledge of god. thy word, is sun, our light divine, our guide in noon-day bright, a lamp unto our feet always from dangers of the night. the word is everlasting truth it is all clean and pure, our guide in all our joyful days, a staff for our old age.

lines: How shall our children and young ones
Take heed and cleanse their way,
Only by taking heed thereto
According to Thy word.
Thy word entered into the heart,
And sheds its light abroad,
It gives wisdom's to the simple,
And the knowledge of God.
Thy word, is sun, our light Divine,
Our guide in noon-day bright,
A lamp unto our feet always
From dangers of the night.
The word is everlasting Truth
It is all clean and pure,
Our guide in all our joyful days,
A staff for our old age.

hymns.title: How shall our children and young ones

hymns.searchText: jesus christ make me hear thy voice hymn_1768344402261_0_15db342e christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide jesus christ make me hear thy voice speak thou be word of peace and all my strength shall be employed in praise of thy goodness. in thy mercy, call me thy child forgive me all my sins and then, thy voice will sound so sweet like heaven's harmony. where ever thou wants me to go i'll gladly follow thee and gladly will i fellowship with those who are asleep. when this burden of sin is gone no other load remains the hand that scatter'd forgiveness will give the crown of life.

lines: Jesus Christ make me hear Thy voice
Speak Thou be word of peace
And all my strength shall be employed
In praise of Thy goodness.
In Thy mercy, call me Thy child
Forgive me all my sins
And then, Thy voice will sound so sweet
Like heaven's harmony.
Where ever Thou wants me to go
I'll gladly follow Thee
And gladly will I fellowship
With those who are asleep.
When this burden of sin is gone
No other load remains
The hand that scatter'd forgiveness
Will give the crown of life.

hymns.title: Jesus Christ make me hear Thy voice

hymns.searchText: the spirit breathes upon the word, hymn_1768344402261_0_b8cd33d6 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide the spirit breathes upon the word, and brings the truth to sight; precepts and promises afford, a sanctifying light. a glory glids the sacred page, majestic, like the sun, it gives a light to every age; it gives but borrows none, the hand that give it shall supplies the gracious light and heat; his truths upon the nations raise, they rise, but never set. let everlasting thanks be thine for such a bright display as makes a world of darkness shine with brighter worlds above. my soul rejoice to pursue the steps of him i love, till glory breaks upon my view in brighter worlds above.

lines: The Spirit breathes upon the word,
And brings the truth to sight;
Precepts and promises afford,
A sanctifying light.
A glory glids the sacred page,
Majestic, like the sun,
It gives a light to every age;
It gives but borrows none,
The hand that give it shall supplies
The gracious light and heat;
His truths upon the nations raise,
They rise, but never set.
Let everlasting thanks be Thine
For such a bright display
As makes a world of darkness shine
With brighter worlds above.
My soul rejoice to pursue
The steps of Him I love,
Till glory breaks upon my view
In brighter worlds above.

hymns.title: The Spirit breathes upon the word,

hymns.searchText: the bible everlasting book! hymn_1768344402261_0_d219ee65 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide the bible everlasting book! who knows thy deep secrets? your beginning on earth who knows? and who can know thy end? the secrets of the god of heaven, ambassador from heaven; the sword that kill'd the sting of death, god's own image divine. a book indeed among thousands a book of ancient days, thou made salvation way so plain to all mankind on earth. the treasure of the three-in-one the blessed trinity do, interpret thyself to me and all my doubts dispel. thy pages i'll open with pray'r to learn thy doctrines lord; the everlasting book divine show me the saviour's love.

lines: The Bible everlasting book!
Who knows thy deep secrets?
Your beginning on earth who knows?
And who can know Thy end?
The secrets of the God of heaven,
Ambassador from heaven;
The sword that kill'd the sting of death,
God's own image divine.
A book indeed among thousands
A book of ancient days,
Thou made salvation way so plain
To all mankind on earth.
The treasure of the Three-in-One
The blessed Trinity
Do, interpret Thyself to me
And all my doubts dispel.
Thy pages I'll open with pray'r
To learn Thy doctrines Lord;
The everlasting Book divine
Show me the Saviour's love.

hymns.title: The Bible everlasting book!

hymns.searchText: 8.8.d. hymn_1768344402261_0_efe119b2 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 8.8.d. the word is a lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path. ps. 119:105. come, o thou prophet of the lord, thou great interpreter divine. explain thine own transmitted word, to teach and to inspire is thine; thou only canst thyself reveal, open the book, and loose the seal. whate'er the ancient prophet spoke concerning thee, o christ, make known; chief subject of the sacred book, thou fillest all, and thou alone; yet there our lord we cannot see, unless thy spirit lend the key. now, jesus, now the veil remove the folly of our darkened heart; unfold the wonders of thy love, the knowledge of thyself impart: our ear, our inmost soul, we bow; speak, lord; thy servants hearken.

lines: The word is a lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path. Ps. 119:105.
Come, O Thou Prophet of the Lord,
Thou great Interpreter divine.
Explain Thine own transmitted word,
To teach and to inspire is Thine;
Thou only canst Thyself reveal,
Open the book, and loose the seal.
Whate'er the ancient prophet spoke
Concerning Thee, O Christ, make known;
Chief subject of the sacred book,
Thou fillest all, and Thou alone;
Yet there our Lord we cannot see,
Unless Thy Spirit lend the key.
Now, Jesus, now the veil remove
The folly of our darkened heart;
Unfold the wonders of Thy love,
The knowledge of Thyself impart:
Our ear, our inmost soul, we bow;
Speak, Lord; Thy servants hearken.

hymns.title: 8.8.D.

lines: The Holy scriptures which are able to make thee wise, unto salvation. II Tim. 3:15
I love the Holy Bible, Lord
It gives joy, and light to the path
Of sore distressed and gloomy hearts,
It makes my crocked pathway straight,
From straying Thy fear has kept me
Thy promises give my heart rest.
Thy fear roused me from deep slumber
And portary'd where my danger lurk'd
After humbling my sinful alone
di	It is Thy word, Thy word alone
That cleans'd and sanctified my soul
And brought down thy free grace to me.
Who can understand his errors
My secret fauls may Thou forgive
di	Keep me back from presumptious sin
Accept the humble praise I bring
For all these blessings and Thy grace
Give me a grateful heart, O Lord.

hymns.title: 8.8.D.

hymns.searchText: 10.11.10.&.ref. hymn_1768344402261_0_fd76cb08 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 10.11.10.&.ref. search the holy scriptures.. joh. 5:39. cling to the bible, tho' all else be taken; lose not its precepts so precious and pure; souls that are sleeping its tidings life from the dead in its promises sure. cling to the bible! (3c3) our lamp and our guide. cling to the bible! this jewel and treasure brings life eternal, and saves fallen man; surely its value no mortal can measure seek for its blessing, o soul, while you can! lamp for the feet that in by-ways have wander'd guide for the youth that would otherwise fall; hope for th sinner whose life has been squander'd staff for th aged, and best book of all.

lines: Search the Holy Scriptures.. Joh. 5:39.
Cling to the Bible, tho' all else be taken;
Lose not its precepts so precious and pure;
Souls that are sleeping its tidings
Life from the dead in its promises sure.
Cling to the Bible! (3c3)
Our Lamp and our Guide.
Cling to the Bible! this jewel and treasure
Brings life eternal, and saves fallen man;
Surely its value no mortal can measure
Seek for its blessing, O soul, while you can!
Lamp for the feet that in by-ways have wander'd
Guide for the youth that would otherwise fall;
Hope for th sinner whose life has been squander'd
Staff for th aged, and best book of all.

hymns.title: 10.11.10.&.Ref.

hymns.searchText: talk with us, lord, thyself reveal, hymn_1768344402262_0_9c3d2435 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide talk with us, lord, thyself reveal, while here o'er earth we rove, speak to our hearts, and let us feel the kindling of thy love. with thee conversing, we forget all time, and toil, and care, labour is rest, and pain is sweet, if thou, my god, art here. here then, my god, vouchsafe to stay, and bid my heart rejoice, my bounding heart shall own the sway, and echo to thy voice. thou callest me to seek the face; "'tis all i wish to seek; to attend the whispers of thy grace, and hear thee inly speak. let my every hour employ, till i thy glory see, enter into my master's joy, and find my heav'n in thee.

lines: Talk with us, Lord, Thyself reveal,
While here o'er earth we rove,
Speak to our hearts, and let us feel
The kindling of Thy love.
With Thee conversing, we forget
All time, and toil, and care,
Labour is rest, and pain is sweet,
If Thou, my God, art here.
Here then, my God, vouchsafe to stay,
And bid my heart rejoice,
My bounding heart shall own the sway,
And echo to Thy voice.
Thou callest me to seek The face;
"'Tis all I wish to seek;
To attend the whispers of Thy grace,
And hear Thee inly speak.
Let my every hour employ,
Till I Thy glory see,
Enter into my Master's joy,
And find my heav'n in Thee.

hymns.title: Talk with us, Lord, Thyself reveal,

hymns.searchText: jesus, we lift our souls so thee, hymn_1768344402262_0_678a6d8a christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide jesus, we lift our souls so thee, thy holy spirit breathe; and let these little infants be baptized into thy death. oh let thine unction on them rest; thy grace their souls renew; and write within their tender breast thy name and nature too. thy faithful servants let them prove girded with truth divine, be sharers in thy dying love, and followers of thine, lord, plant us all into thy death, that we thy life may prove; partakes of thy cross beneath, and of thy crown above.

lines: Jesus, we lift our souls so Thee,
Thy Holy Spirit breathe;
And let these little infants be
Baptized into Thy death.
Oh let Thine unction on them rest;
Thy grace their souls renew;
And write within their tender breast
Thy name and nature too.
Thy faithful servants let them prove
Girded with truth divine,
Be sharers in Thy dying love,
And followers of Thine,
Lord, plant us all into Thy death,
That we Thy life may prove;
Partakes of Thy cross beneath,
And of Thy crown above.

hymns.title: Jesus, we lift our souls so Thee,

hymns.searchText: 10.10.10.&.ref. hymn_1768344402262_0_744aaf0a christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 10.10.10.&.ref. behold what manner of love the father hath bestowed upon us that we should be called the children of god. 1. john. 3:1. i am so glad that our father in heaven tell of his love in the book he has given; wonderful things in the bible i see; this is the dearest, that jesus loves me. i am so glad that jesus loves me. jesus loves me, jesus loves me i am so glad that jesus loves me, jesus loves even me. though i forget him, and wander away, still he doth love me wherever i stray; back to his dear loving arms do i flee when i remember that jesus loves me. oh, if there's only one song i can sing, when in his beauty i see the great king. this shall my song in eternity be, "oh, what a wonder that jesus loves me!" jesus loves me, and i know i love him; love brought him down my poor soul to redeem, yes, it was love made him die on the tree oh, i am certain that jesus loves me! if one should ask of me, how can i tell? glory to jesus, i know very well! god's holy spirit with mine doth agree. constantly witnessing - jesus loves me

lines: Behold what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us that we should
be called the children of God. 1. John. 3:1.
I am so glad that our Father in heaven
Tell of His love in the Book He has given;
Wonderful things in the Bible I see;
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.
I am so glad that Jesus loves me.
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.
Though I forget Him, and wander away,
Still he doth love me wherever I stray;
Back to His dear loving arms do I flee
When I remember that Jesus loves me.
Oh, if there's only one song I can sing,
When in His beauty I see the great King.
This shall my song in eternity be,
"Oh, what a wonder that Jesus loves me!"
Jesus loves me, and I know I love Him;
Love brought Him down my poor soul to redeem,
Yes, it was love made Him die on the tree
Oh, I am certain that Jesus loves me!
If one should ask of me, how can I tell?
Glory to Jesus, I know very well!
God's Holy Spirit with mine doth agree.
Constantly witnessing - Jesus loves me

hymns.title: 10.10.10.&.Ref.

hymns.searchText: 7.7.7.d. hymn_1768344402262_0_b65d1f6b christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7.7.7.d. this is my beloved son, in whom i am well pleased. matt. 3:17. jesus who came down to save went down to river jordan; he came out from the water through the father's voice from heav'n and the descent of the dove' jesus christ, my great guide thou i would be baptized like thee. in the garden, where he prayed grief o'er flow'd him like a flood, on the cross of calvary there, the saviour died for me nail'd together with the lord my hope is that, jesus died; i have my place by his feet, i suffer all things for him. in a new tomb was he laid he, the fear and dread removed he, the stone grave could not hold and was glorified for aye; i would be buried with christ as th' ordinance i partake, as i'm raised from the water a new life with god to live.

lines: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Matt. 3:17.
Jesus who came down to save
Went down to River Jordan;
He came out from the water
Through the Father's voice from heav'n
And the descent of the dove'
Jesus Christ, my great guide Thou
I would be baptized like Thee.
In the garden, where He prayed
Grief o'er flow'd Him like a flood,
On the cross of Calvary
There, the Saviour died for me
Nail'd together with the Lord
My hope is that, Jesus died;
I have my place by His feet,
I suffer all things for Him.
In a new tomb was He laid
He, the fear and dread removed
He, the stone grave could not hold
And was glorified for aye;
I would be buried with Christ
As th' ordinance I partake,
As I'm raised from the water
A new life with God to live.

hymns.title: 7.7.7.D.

hymns.searchText: 8.9.8.8.8.8.4. hymn_1768344402262_0_ccc15839 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 8.9.8.8.8.8.4. open thou mine eyes that i may behold wondrous things our of thy law ps. 119:18. open my eyes, but that i may see glimpses of truth thou hast for me; place in my hands the wonderful key that shall unclasp and set me free, silently now i wait for thee, ready, my god, thy will to see, open my eyes, illumine me, spirit divine! open my ears, that i may hear voices of truth thou sendest clear; and while the wave-notes fall on my ear everything false will disappear, silently now i wait for thee ready, my god, thy will to see; open my eyes, illumine me, spirit divine! open my mouth, and let me bear gladly the warm truth everywhere, open my heart and let me prepare love with thy children thus to share silently now i wait for thee ready, my god, thy will to see; open my eyes, illumine me, spirit divine! open my mind, that i may read, more to thy love in word and deed; what shall i fear while yet thou dost lead? only for light from thee i plead, silently now i wait for thee ready, my god, thy will to see; open my eyes, illumine me, spirit divine! open my way, that i may bring trophies of grace to the, my king, echoed in love thy word shall out-ring sweet as the note that angels sing, silently now i wait for thee ready, my god, thy will to see; open my eyes, illumine me, spirit divine!

lines: Open thou mine eyes that I may behold wondrous things our of thy law Ps. 119:18.
Open my eyes, but that I may see
Glimpses of truth Thou hast for me;
Place in my hands the wonderful key
That shall unclasp and set me free,
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see,
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit Divine!
Open my ears, that I may hear
Voices of truth Thou sendest clear;
And while the wave-notes fall on my ear
Everything false will disappear,
Silently now I wait for Thee
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit Divine!
Open my mouth, and let me bear
Gladly the warm truth everywhere,
Open my heart and let me prepare
Love with Thy children thus to share
Silently now I wait for Thee
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit Divine!
Open my mind, that I may read,
More to Thy love in word and deed;
What shall I fear while yet Thou dost lead?
Only for light from Thee I plead,
Silently now I wait for Thee
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit Divine!
Open my Way, that I may bring
Trophies of grace to The, my King,
Echoed in love Thy word shall out-ring
Sweet as the note that angels sing,
Silently now I wait for Thee
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit Divine!

hymns.searchText: come holy ghost descend from high hymn_1768344402262_0_fa6d3f32 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide come holy ghost descend from high baptizer of our spirits thou the sacramental seal apply and witness with the water now. pour faith thy energy divine and sprinkle the atoning blood, may father, son and spirit join to seal this child, a child of god.

lines: Come holy ghost descend from high
Baptizer of our spirits Thou

And witness with the water now.

And sprinkle the atoning blood,
May Father, Son and Spirit join
To seal this child, a child of God.

hymns.title: Come holy ghost descend from high

lines: We are baptised unto His death

hymns.title: Have we e'er heard those weighty words,

hymns.searchText: o lord, would thy pardon hymn_1768344402263_0_75014f5b christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide o lord, would thy pardon such a sinner like me? has my sins been carried away and has thou made me glad? could it be that the cross you bore for me, despising shame? ought i then, lord to be ashamed of thus being baptised? thou made thyself an example in waters of jordan; why should my pride refuse to yield to do what thou has done? jesus, the zeal of love thou shows blames my own cold response, but my feet now is swift to walk in the way of thy will.

lines: O Lord, would Thy pardon
Such a sinner like me?
Has my sins been carried away
And has Thou made me glad?
Could it be that the Cross you bore
For me, despising shame?
Ought I then, Lord to be ashamed
Of thus being baptised?
Thou made Thyself an example
In waters of Jordan;
Why should my pride refuse to yield
To do what Thou has done?
Jesus, the zeal of love Thou shows
Blames my own cold response,
But my feet now is swift to walk
In the way of Thy will.

hymns.title: O Lord, would Thy pardon

hymns.searchText: stand, soldier of the cross, hymn_1768344402263_0_d5cbf8a4 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide stand, soldier of the cross, thy high allegiance claim, and vow to hold the world but loss for thy redeemer's name. arise, and be baptized and wash thy sins away; the league with god be solemnized, thy faith avouch'd today. in god's whole armour strong front hell's embattled pow'rs, apostles, seers, evangelists, and martyr throngs enrolled in god's whole armour strong front hell's embattled pow'rs, the warfare may be sharp and long the vict'ry must be ours. oh, bright the conqu'ror's crown, the song of triumph sweet, when faith casts every trophy down at our great captain's feet.

lines: Stand, soldier of the cross,
Thy high allegiance claim,
And vow to hold the world but loss
For Thy Redeemer's name.
Arise, and be baptized
And wash thy sins away;
The league with God be solemnized,
Thy faith avouch'd today.
In God's whole armour strong
Front hell's embattled pow'rs,
Apostles, seers, evangelists,
And martyr throngs enrolled
In God's whole armour strong
Front hell's embattled pow'rs,
The warfare may be sharp and long
The vict'ry must be ours.
Oh, bright the conqu'ror's crown,
The song of triumph sweet,
When faith casts every trophy down
At our great Captain's feet.

hymns.title: Stand, soldier of the cross,

hymns.searchText: hear the voice from heaven saying hymn_1768344402264_0_6cdc0280 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide hear the voice from heaven saying to jesus, in river jordan a witness is to all the world "this is my own beloved son". without sin he and perfect but to fulfil all righteousness of baptism in the water he made himself an example. son of the father's own bosom is salvation for all mankind the source of life for the sinner jordan, brought near to calvary. come, thou, follow now thy saviour obey the command, be baptised example of death with jesus and the resurrection with him come, do not be curious to know a secret which the lord would keep put obedience first and at last the result will them be revealed.

lines: Hear the voice from heaven saying
To Jesus, in River Jordan
A witness is to all the world
"This is my own beloved Son".
Without sin He and perfect
But to fulfil all righteousness
Of baptism in the water
He made Himself an example.
Son of the Father's own bosom
Is Salvation for all mankind
The source of life for the sinner
Jordan, brought near to Calvary.
Come, thou, follow now thy Saviour
Obey the command, be baptised
Example of death with Jesus
And the resurrection with Him
Come, do not be curious to know
A secret which the Lord would keep
Put obedience first and at last
The result will them be revealed.

hymns.title: Hear the voice from heaven saying

lines: Preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.Luk. 3:3
The voice that sound in the desert
It's the voice of watchman
Hark as the voice now calling
Calling for repentance
The voice as it was sounding
Art thou not now concern'd
And why, O brothers, sisters
Do you feel unconcern'd.
The kingdom is now at hand
The kingdom of our Lord
And those that wash their garments
Shall sit on royal throne
Why do you feel unconcern'd?
To the voice of watchman?
Which sound new to thee clearly
Seeking for repentance.
The Abner and Pharpar stream
They may be clean water
But the command of cleans
Is in river Jordan
Throw all thy thoughts to one side
And do the will of God
Now descend into this stream
And wash and be thou clean
What's now keeping you waiting?
What can be your excuse?
Behold the steam and Thy John
All things are now ready
`	You have argued for long time
Will you die with spirit?
Sinners hear the watchman's voice
And come to repentance.

hymns.title: 6.7.6.D.

hymns.searchText: almighty, god of heav'n and earth hymn_1768344402264_0_91aa347c christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide almighty, god of heav'n and earth jesus the son, that became flesh holy spirit, for all our care hear us and receive all our vows. we accept thee, thou who art slain thou who ascended up to heav'n with thee, we are dead unto sin our hearts would be raised up with thee. we want to believe thy gospel we go, and thy hand leads us on; at jordan, we seek for the way that thy own disciples have trod. by baptism - a great token we surrender ourselves to thee; put thy seal on the covenant and make us forever thine own.

lines: Almighty, God of heav'n and earth
Jesus the Son, that became flesh
Holy Spirit, for all our care
Hear us and receive all our vows.
We accept Thee, Thou who art slain
Thou who ascended up to heav'n
With Thee, we are dead unto sin
Our hearts would be raised up with Thee.
We want to believe Thy gospel
We go, and Thy hand leads us on;
At Jordan, we seek for the way
That Thy own disciples have trod.
By baptism - a great token
We surrender ourselves to Thee;
Put Thy seal on the covenant
And make us forever Thine own.

hymns.title: Almighty, God of heav'n and earth

lines: And the blood of Jesus Christ His Son cleanseth us from all  sin. 1Joh. 1:7.
I know there is pow'r in Jesus' blood
For He wash'd my sins away,
And I know there is joy in serving Him
For He turnedmy night to day.
There is power, power, wonder working power
There is power, power, purifying power,
There is pow'r in Jesus blood.
I know there is pow'r in Jesus' blood
From my guilt He set me free,

hymns.searchText: 7.8.7.4.7. hymn_1768344402264_0_ac608130 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7.8.7.4.7. he that believeth and is baptised shall be saved but he that believeth not shall be danned. mk. 16:16. see these ones in white apparel standing by the river's brink their backs turned to the world and sin and waiting to be baptised and expecting to fulfil the lord's command. blood, now they stand there in fear but they not of hope bereft they know that their blessed saviour commanded their immersion jordan is cold, but their faith is waxing hot. behold and see, other brethren their elders in jesus christ stretch out hands of love to help them they have been like them before at this moment, they rejoice in pard'ing grace. go, follow your saviour and lord behold with the eye of faith the heavens open: god's spirit loudly saying from heaven "these disciples, are my beloved children".

lines: He that believeth and is baptised shall be saved but he
that believeth not shall be danned. Mk. 16:16.
See these ones in white apparel
Standing by the river's brink
Their backs turned to the world and sin
And waiting to be baptised
And expecting
To fulfil the Lord's Command.
Blood, now they stand there in fear
But they not of hope bereft
They know that their blessed Saviour
Commanded their immersion
Jordan is cold,
But their faith is waxing hot.
Behold and see, other brethren
Their elders in Jesus Christ
Stretch out hands of love to help them
They have been like them before
At this moment,
They rejoice in pard'ing grace.
Go, follow your Saviour and Lord
Behold with the eye of faith
The heavens open: God's spirit
Loudly saying from heaven
"These disciples,
Are my beloved children".

lines: `	Jesus, thou Joy of loving hearts,
Thou Fount of life, Thou Light of men
di	From the best bliss that earth imparts
We turn unfilled to Thee again.
Thy truth unchanged hath ever stood;
Thou savest those that on Thee call;
To them that seek Thee Thou art good,
To them that find thee, all in all.
We taste Thee, O Thou living Bread,
And long to feast upon Thee still,
We drink for Thee, the fountain-head,

make all our moments calm and bright,

hymns.title: `	Jesus, thou Joy of loving hearts,

hymns.searchText: 6.6.6. hymn_1768344402265_0_11ad8924 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 6.6.6. the bread that i will give is my flesh for the life of the world. john. 6:51. i hunger and i thirst, jesus, my manna be; ye living waters, burst out of the rock for me. thou bruised and broken bread, my life-long wants supply; as living souls are fed, o feed me, or i die thou true life-giving vine, let me thy sweetness prove, renew my life with thine, refresh my soul with love. rough paths my feet have trod, since first their course began, feed me, thou bread of god; di help me, thou son of man. thou still the desert lies my thirsting soul before, o living waters rise within me evermore.

lines: The bread that I will give is my flesh for the life of the world. John. 6:51.
I hunger and I thirst,
Jesus, my manna be;
Ye living waters, burst
Out of the rock for me.
Thou bruised and broken Bread,
My life-long wants supply;
As living souls are fed,
O feed me, or I die
Thou true life-giving Vine,
Let me Thy sweetness prove,
Renew my life with Thine,
Refresh my soul with love.
Rough paths my feet have trod,
Since first their course began,
Feed me, Thou Bread of God;
di	Help me, Thou Son of Man.
Thou still the desert lies
My thirsting soul before,
O living waters rise
Within me evermore.

lines: Give ear, O shepherd of Israel, thou who leadest Joseph like a flock. Ps. 80:1.
O King of mercy, from thy throne on high
Look down in love, and hear our humble cry
Thou tender Shepherd of the blood-bought cry
Thy feeble wand'ring flock in safety keep.
O gentle Saviour, by thy death we live;
To contrite sinner's life eternal give.
Thou art the Bread of heav'n on Thee we feed,
Be near to help our souls in time of need.
Thou art the mourner's Stay, the sinner's Friend.
Sweet Fount of joy and blessings without God.
O come and cheer us with Thy heav'nly grace,
Reveal the brightness of Thy glorious face.
In cooling cloud by day, in fire by night,
Be near our steps, and make our darkness light,
Go where we go, abide where we abide,
In life, in death, our Comfort, Strength and Guide
O lead us daily with Thine eye of love,
And bring us safety to our home above.

lines: This is my body which is given for you.
This do in remembrance of me. Luk. 22:19.
Drawn nigh and take the Blood of the Lord,
And drink the holy Blood for you out-poured.
Saved by His Body, hallowed by His Blood,
With souls refreshed we render thanks to God.
Salvation's Giver, Christ, the only Son,
By His dear Cross and Blood the vict'ry won.
di	Offer'd was He for greatest and for least,
Himself the Victim and Himself the priest.
He, Ransomer from death, and Light from shade
Now gives His Holy grace His saints to aid.
Approach ye then with faithful hearts sincere,
And take the pledge of Salvation here.
He, that in this world rules His saint, and shields,
To all believers life eternal yields.
With Heav'nly Bread makes them that hunger whole,
Gives Living Waters to the thirsting soul.
O Judge of all, our only Saviour Thou,
In this Thy feast of love be with us now.

hymns.searchText: 7.7.7.d. hymn_1768344402265_0_b5ad3bf2 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide 7.7.7.d. lord, to whom shall we go. john. 6:68. lord, tow whom except to thee shall our wand'ring spirits go; thee whom it is light to see, and eternal life to know? awful is that life of thine which the spirit's breath inspires, and the food must be divine which each new-born soul desires. israel on heavenly seed fed and died in days of yore, but the souls, that on thee feed, never thirst nor hunger more, lord, to whom except to thee shall we go when ills betide? who except thyself can be hope and help and strength and guide? who can cleanse the soul from sin, hear the pray'r, and seal the vow? who can fill the void within, blessed saviour, who but thou? therefor evermore i'll give land and praise, my god, to thee, evermore in thee i live, evermore live thou in me.

lines: Lord, to whom shall we go. John. 6:68.
Lord, tow whom except to Thee
Shall our wand'ring spirits go;
Thee Whom it is light to see,
And Eternal Life to know?
Awful is that Life of Thine
Which the Spirit's Breath inspires,
And the food must be Divine
Which each new-born soul desires.
Israel on Heavenly seed
Fed and died in days of yore,
But the souls, that on Thee feed,
Never thirst nor hunger more,
Lord, to whom except to Thee
Shall we go when ills betide?
Who except Thyself can be
Hope and help and strength and guide?
Who can cleanse the soul from sin,
Hear the pray'r, and seal the vow?
Who can fill the void within,
Blessed Saviour, who but Thou?
Therefor evermore I'll give
Land and praise, my God, to Thee,
Evermore in Thee I live,
Evermore live Thou in me.

hymns.title: 7.7.7.D.

lines: And I	I will love him, and will manifest myself to him. John. 14:21.
Here, O my Lord, I see Thee face to face;
Here would I touch and handle things unseen,
Here grasp with firmer hand the eternal grace,
And all my weariness upon the Thee lean.
Here would I feed upon the bread of God,
Here drink with Thee the royal wine of heav'n,
Here would I lay aside the each earthly load,
Here taste afresh the calm of sin forgiven.
I have no help but Thine; nor do I need
Another arm save Thee to lean upon;
It is enough, my Lord, enough indeed;
My strength is in Thy might, Thy might alone.
Mine is the sin, but Thine the righteousness;
Mine is the guilt,. but Thine the cleansing blood;
Here is my robe, my refuge, and my peace
Thy blood, Thy righteousness, O Lord, my God.
Too soon we rise, the symbols disappear
The feast, though not the love, is passed and gone
The bread and wine remove, but Thou art there-
Nearer than ever-still my shield and sun.
di	Feast after feast thus comes and passes by;
Yet, passing, points to the glad feast above,
Giving sweet foretaste of the festal joy,
The Lamb's great bridal feast of bliss and love.

lines: And the blood of Jesus Christ His Son cleanseth us from all sin. 1 John. 1:7.
What can wash away my sin?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Oh, precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow!
No other fount I know;
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
For my cleansing this I see
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
For my pardon this my plea-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Nothing can for sin atone-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Nought of good that I have done-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
This is all my hope and peace-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
This is all my righteousness
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

hymns.searchText: according to thy gracious word, hymn_1768344402265_0_e495e200 christ apostolic church (cac) worldwide according to thy gracious word, in meek humility, this will i do, my dying lord, i will remember thee. the body, broken for my sake, my bread from heaven shall be, thy testmental cup i take, and thus remember thee. gethsemane can i forget? or there thy conflict see, thine agony and blody sweat, and not remember thee? when to the croo i am mine eyes and rest on calvary, o lamb of god, my sacrifices, i must remember thee. remember thee, and all thy pains, and all thy love to me; yea, while a breath, a pulse remains, will i remember thee. and when these failing lips grow dumb, and mind and mem'ry flee, when thou shalt in thy kingdom come, jesus, remember me.

lines: According to thy gracious word,
In meek humility,
This will I do, my dying Lord,
I will remember thee.
The body, broken for my sake,
My bread from heaven shall be,
Thy testmental cup I take,
And thus remember thee.
Gethsemane can I forget?
Or there thy conflict see,
Thine agony and blody sweat,
And not remember thee?
When to the croo I am mine eyes
And rest on Calvary,
O Lamb of God, my sacrifices,
I must remember thee.
Remember thee, and all thy pains,
And all thy love to me;
Yea, while a breath, a pulse remains,
Will I remember thee.
And when these failing lips grow dumb,
And mind and mem'ry flee,
When thou shalt in thy Kingdom come,
Jesus, remember me.

hymns.title: According to thy gracious word,

Thy Ordinance,
Two should come together dwell

lines: For in Cana of Galilee
At that blest marriage feast
Jesus was present in that place
And His disciples too.
Jesus reveal Thyself we pray
At this holy wedding
And bestow all of Thy blessing
Upon husband and wife
Let them both be in fellowship
All the days of their life,
Let Thy divine love be the tie
That the world cannot break
That they may one another help
By working together
Grant them Thy peace, O Lord, we pray
And true satisfaction
Like the first blessings Thou give in
The Garden of Eden
That they may go and multiply
Until their lives shall end

lines: Thou shalt lie down and thy sleep shall be sweet prov.3:24
Now the day is over,
Night is drawing nigh,
Shadows of the evening
Steal across the sky.
Now the darkness gathers,
Stars their watches keep,
Bride and beasts, and flower
Soon will be asleep,
Jesus, give the weary
Calm and sweet repose;
With Thy tend'rest blessing
May mine eyelids close
Grant to little children
Visions bright of Thee
Guard the sailors tossing
On the deep blue sea
Comfort every suffer
Watching late in pain:
Those who plan some evil
From their sin restrain,
Through the morning wakens,
May Thine angles spread
Their white wings above me,
Watching round my bed.
When the morning  wakens,
Then may I arise
pure and fresh, and sinless
In Thy holy eyes
Glory to the Father,
Glory to the son,
And to Thee, blest sprit,
Whilst all ages run

lines: Jesus, do manifest Thyself
At this matrimony
We beseech Thee to come, O Lord
Reveal Thyself to us
Pour Thy blessing upon these ones
Whose hands are joined in ones
Look down in favour of their match
And bless this their union
Fill both their bosoms with Thy love
Give to them Thy peace
O Lord, we pray
And supply all their needs,
Through Thy perfect love, make them one
That they ,may by Christ's love,
Make domestic care become light
By helping each other.
Let them be help to each other
In matter of their faith
And bless thou them with good children
Who will stablish their home.

hymns.title: Jesus, do manifest Thyself

lines: Resist the devil and he will flee from you. James 4:7

Speak no angry word;

lines: Speak Lord for Thy servant heareth. 1 sam.3:9
When little Samuel woke
And heard his master's voice
At ev'ry word he spoke
How much did he rejoice
Oh, blessed happy child to find
The God of heav'n so near and kind
If God would speak to me
And say He is my Friend
How happy l should be
Oh how would l attend
How smallest Sin l then should be
If God Almighty were so near.
And does He never speak?
Oh, yes for His word
He bids me come and seek
The God that Samuel heard
In almost ev'ry page l see
The God of Samuel calls to me.
And l beneath His care
May safely rest my head
l know that God is there
To guard my humble bed
And every sin l well may fear
Since God Almighty is so- near.
Like Samuel let me say
When'er ; read Thy word
Speak, Lord l would obey
The voice that l have heard
And when l in Thy servant wait to hear

lines: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea. Matt 2:l
Once in royal David's city
Stood a lowly cattle-shed,
Where a mother laid her baby
In a manger for His bed
Mary was that mother mild,
Jesus Christ her little child.
He came down to earth from heaven.
Who is God and Lord of all,
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall,
With the poor, and mean, and lowly
Live on earth our Saviour holy.
And through all His wondrous childhood
He would honour and obey
Love and watch the lowly maiden
In whose gentle arms He lay
Christian children all must be
Mild, obedient, good as He
For He is our childhood's pattern;
Day by day like us He grew;
He was little, weak, and helpless;
Tears and smiles like us He knew
And He feeleth for our sadness.
And He share the in our gladness.
And our eyes at last shall see Him,
Through His own redeeming love;
For that child so dear and gentle
Is our Lord I heaven above?
And He leads His children on
To the place where He is gone
Not in poor lowly stable,
With the oxen standing by,
We shall see Him; but in Heaven,
We at God's right hand o high;
When like stars His children crown'd
All in shall wait around.

lines: There is a path lead to God,
All other go astray;
Narrow but pleasant is the road,
And Christians love the way;
It leads straight through this world of sin,
And danger must be pass'd;
But whose who boldly walk therein
Will get to heav'n at last
How shall an infant pilgrim dare
This dangerous path to tread?
For on the way's many a snare
For youthful  travellers spread.
White the broad road where thousands go,
Lies near and opens fair,
And many turn aside, l know,
To walk with sinners there
But least my feeble steps should slide,
Or wander from thy way,
Lord, condescend to be my guide,
And l shall never stray
Then l may go without alarm
And trust His word of old
"The lambs, He'll gather with His arm,
And lead them to the fold"
Thus l may safely venture through
Beneath my Shepherd's care
And keep the gate of heav'n in view,
Till l shall enter there

hymns.title: There is a path lead to God,
